name: Mission Control v0.1.0 - Persistent Project Storage

files.content:
[package]
name = "mission-control"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Mission Control development workflow application"
authors = ["Mission Control"]
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "mission_control_lib"
crate-type = ["staticlib", "cdylib", "rlib"]

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = [] }

[dependencies]
rusqlite = { version = "0.32", features = ["bundled"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
tauri = { version = "2", features = [] }
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planning'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'planning',
                'active',
                'paused',
                'blocked',
                'waiting',
                'completed',
                'archived'
            )
        ),

    priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
        CHECK (
            priority IN (
                'none',
                'low',
                'medium',
                'high',
                'critical'
            )
        ),

    current_version TEXT,
    current_phase TEXT,
    current_step TEXT,
    last_completed_step TEXT,

    local_path TEXT,
    repository_url TEXT,

    icon TEXT,
    category TEXT,

    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    archived_at TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status
    ON projects(status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_updated_at
    ON projects(updated_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activities (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id TEXT,

    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_type TEXT,
    entity_id TEXT,

    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata_json TEXT,

    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY(project_id)
        REFERENCES projects(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_activities_project
    ON activities(project_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_activities_created_at
    ON activities(created_at DESC);

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct Project {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub slug: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,

    pub status: String,
    pub priority: String,

    pub current_version: Option<String>,
    pub current_phase: Option<String>,
    pub current_step: Option<String>,
    pub last_completed_step: Option<String>,

    pub local_path: Option<String>,
    pub repository_url: Option<String>,

    pub icon: Option<String>,
    pub category: Option<String>,

    pub created_at: String,
    pub updated_at: String,
    pub archived_at: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CreateProjectInput {
    pub name: String,
    pub slug: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,

    pub status: Option<String>,
    pub priority: Option<String>,

    pub current_version: Option<String>,
    pub current_phase: Option<String>,
    pub current_step: Option<String>,
    pub last_completed_step: Option<String>,

    pub local_path: Option<String>,
    pub repository_url: Option<String>,

    pub icon: Option<String>,
    pub category: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct UpdateProjectInput {
    pub name: String,
    pub slug: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,

    pub status: String,
    pub priority: String,

    pub current_version: Option<String>,
    pub current_phase: Option<String>,
    pub current_step: Option<String>,
    pub last_completed_step: Option<String>,

    pub local_path: Option<String>,
    pub repository_url: Option<String>,

    pub icon: Option<String>,
    pub category: Option<String>,
}
